Elena / Jordan — I reviewed the redlined MSA and put together a short summary of proposed language and open items. Attaching annotated MSA for reference (Redwood_MSA_annotated.docx). Key points below: 

1) Data retention / access: MediCore requests exports and a longer retention window for audit logs (7 years). Our standard is 2 years with export options; propose compromise of 3 years retention in the MSA with an SLA for expedited export on reasonable request.

2) Indemnity / cap: MediCore's redline removes the liability cap for IP infringement. We can accept a carveout for third-party IP claims and maintain a contract cap tied to 12 months of fees; propose explicit carveouts and mutual representations.

3) Audit rights: We're willing to accept limited audit rights (remote-only, quarterly, scoped) with a reasonable notice period and Redwood confidentiality protections.

4) Order Form & SLA: Confirmed — order form must include token tiers, throughput sizing, and the fallback model variant for capacity events. We'll need the exact API endpoints expected for invoicing/PO reconciliation.

Open technical questions to resolve with Kimberly/ops:
- Does MediCore's PO XML include a canonical tax/jurisdiction element per line? If so, we'll map to our invoice parser but need sample PO XML.
- ACK mechanism: Redwood can support SFTP drop of an ACK file or an API callback; we do not natively support 997 EDI messages without an integration partner.
- PO acceptance window: our standard ACK/accept window is 48 hours; can be shortened to 24 hours if workflow automation is enabled on your side.

If those items are acceptable, I can sign off on a managed exceptions list for the onboarding checklist and we can route a DocuSign envelope for the MSA + Order Form.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_MSA_annotated.docx)

Marissa / Jordan — thanks for the quick review and the annotated doc. A few clarifications from our side:

- ACKs: Our AP can accept an SFTP-placed XML ack that conforms to our internal schema (we'll provide sample). We can do API callbacks too but prefer SFTP for the first 90 days.
- Retention: 3 years is acceptable if we get expedited export and a weekly digest of audit events during the first 12 months.
- Cap / indemnity: MediCore legal can accept a limited cap tied to the first 12 months of fees + carveouts for willful misconduct. We'll prepare a short addendum to reflect that.

Timeline: we'll start Ariba registration this week — if Redwood can confirm SFTP credentials and sample ack by tomorrow we can keep to the one-week signoff target.
